text: Project: AI remake of Ralph Bakshi's Fire and Ice (1983), local-only MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI. Root E:\FNI. Rigs: 5090 box (192.168.12.177:8188, Linux) = dedicated render; 4090 Windows box = LM Studio + general. Never run LM Studio and an H3 render on the same GPU. Hosted adapters disabled (external_spend_limit 0).
Alex approved pipeline plan v2 (docs/plans/2026-09-22-pipeline-v2.md): cut the film into shots, chunk by scene/timecode, render with local H3, assemble with original audio.

shots.jsonl = 1308 shots cut from the master. script/dialogue-timeline.tsv = 290 lines from the SRT with speakers, across 26 scenes (docs/beat-sheet-1.md). Rule: assign lines by cue midpoint, never split a shared cue, never let the VLM name characters.
Alex chose spec v3 over v2 and a fresh run from S03: dialogue from SRT timecodes not ASR; roster entries only from approved stills; chunk cap 2-3 shots or 15s, never cross scene boundaries.
S03 became the pilot scene: stages 1-6 complete, prompts validated 31/31 (s03/6-validation.md). Full-film assignment pass: 290 lines, 0 unassigned, 0 split cues (reports/v3-assignment.md).
Alex: 'name her ice witch' — roster ID ICE WITCH for the dark-skinned afro warrior woman, no timeline lines, scene link still open.
Alex verdict T0001 (S03 ref2v, original stills as refs): 'looks decent keep goin'. First scene that played back. Logged in runs/INDEX.md.
Alex chose to run v3 stages 3-6 for all 26 scenes before any more rendering, rather than queue prompts scene-by-scene.
The 223-prompt queue from late Sept was the broken v2 run (overlapping dialogue, hardcoded 11s). Superseded; those renders are not the film.

Re-chunked all scenes with a hard 15s cap: 195 chunks total. 10 shots exceed 15s on their own (S01 shot:00004 = 73s narration montage, S11/S14/S16 others) and are flagged OVER in the chunk files; they need real splits before render.
Alex verdict T0002 (S03 split at action beats, same refs/seed): 'Those turned out pretty good, we are on the right track'. Action-beat chunking adopted.

Audio: Demucs htdemucs ran on the 4090 (51s for 82min): audio/stems/htdemucs/master_audio_48k_stereo/{vocals,no_vocals}.wav. 253 line clips recut from the vocal stem; 42 shared-cue lines excluded (both voices in one clip); 211 clean clips in audio/lines/, picks pending in audio/voice-review.md.

Audio plan (docs/audio-plan.md): A = original mix over muted video, B = H3 voice refs, C = hybrid (H3 lip sync + original dialogue stem in the mix). C likely winner; tests T0006/T0007/T0008 defined, not run.

Alex's sheet review: oil-paint sheets are the direction; 00017 = best Teegra sheet (4 views, clean circles); flat-cel outputs parked (wrong style, green eyes). Open decisions: earrings silver-vs-gold, pendant design, skin tone, body type — one answer each before sheets become video refs.

Alex's prompt fixes for character sheets: retention tag must match the subject tag; spell circles out one per slot (exactly 6, 2x3); keep the four-view layout (front, side, three-quarter back, back); add neutral expression to the portrait.

Sheet pipeline: graphs/H3CharSheet.json (Fizgig H3 Still nodes, 4096x1536, 18 steps er_sde, ref scaled to 1MP). Template + locked decisions in docs/char-sheet-prompt.md. TEEGRA_sheet_v01.png locked: seed 896723655157649 from teegracover.jpg.

Alex: try six reference inputs, then generate 6 more sheets with random seeds for both Juliana and Nekron. Done: 23 sheets in library/char/sheet-runs/output/ (Juliana 7, Nekron 7, Darkwolf 9), seeds in sheet-runs/seeds.tsv. No verdicts recorded yet.

Darkwolf 'more Frazetta less Bakshi' test: 6 wording variants at one seed/plate (v1 drop-ink, v2 style-first, v3 name-the-painter, v4 two-pass, v5 negative-list, v6 canvas). Verdict pending. 32B VLM test on the 5090 OOM'd at FP16 while rendering; retry with FP8 when idle.

fullrun.py = main pipeline (plan/caption/prompt/render/collect/recover). FL2VA three-field grammar (integrated_multimodal_description/overall_soundscape/non_diegetic_music); REF2VA uses the six-field form. validate_prompt() checks <d> balance, language tags, <=2 speakers, <=130-char lines, <=200-char dialogue; non-fatal.

FULL RUN COMPLETE: 494/494 chunks rendered and downloaded (fullrun/output/, 603MB, ledger fullrun/renders.jsonl matches disk exactly). 34 scene stitches in fullrun/stitched/ = 25 film scenes + 9 gap scenes G01-G09. S10 is the only hole: no renders, separate approach via run_scene10_ledger.py + manifests/scene10_ledger.jsonl.

Absorbed lessons (docs/absorbed-prod-lessons.md) from konte + OpenCineAgent: prompt validator absorbed; measured QC (black/frozen clip motion checks, near-silent audio checks) NOT yet absorbed — ~40 lines, no new deps. Success = downloaded non-empty artifact, never queue state; /history wipes on reboot.

Alex decided the style-LoRA experiment: do BOTH plans. A = 1983 comic/cel style (dataset free: 3924 stills in stills/full/), B = Frazetta oil style (gated on approved styled sheets). Eval = three-way, same chunk + seed: no-LoRA vs comic vs painting. Docs: style-lora-experiment.md; toolkit Musubi-Tuner minimax-h3 fork, Ostris v3 adapter, rank 8, ~500 steps.

Bakshi's own commentary (quoted in style-lora-experiment.md): he wanted Frazetta's painting style, not comic style, 'as that would be impossible' with rotoscope — and 'now we could just do it all with computers'. Green light for plan B as fulfilling the original vision.

Reddit findings folded into fni-h3-pipeline skill: split prompts at action beats; sheets need 'same person, multiple views, don't treat panels as different people'; summary must say [reference generation]; sparkleriley grammar = per-ref keep/drop lists, turntable reel videos as identity refs, environments as numbered subjects; RefMods accept ~4s voice refs (H3 clones the voice; state accents in text; +50% tokens). Turbo LoRAs deep-fry audio.

runs/build_t0002.py (REF2VA template) now emits sheet-aware keep/drop lines via picture_line(): sheets get the multi-view warning, stills get keep-face-hair-costume / drop-pose-framing-background-lighting.

Alex on agent topology: this chat is the long-lived general FNI project channel; multiple short-lived Hermes agents work on aspects while Alex is at the keyboard; GhstClwd is a disconnected OpenClaw used for general chat and to vet Hermes's responses. Alex endorsed adopting the OptChat/OptMem memory pattern for the project.

core/optmem.py = this memory: append-only log (memory/log/), 512-byte summary tree (memory/tree.jsonl), 16KB view (memory/VIEW.md), zoom CLI. Agents: read VIEW.md at start; append rulings with add --kind user and session reports with add --kind work; run pump + view after appending.

Pending human decisions: voice-clip picks (audio/voice-review.md), sheet verdicts (Juliana/Nekron/Darkwolf variants), Teegra earring/pendant/skin/body, S10 approach, T0003-T0005 verdicts, final assembly order + audio mix plan (A/B/C).
